choose.when: AND (B.MOBILE like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) OR B.USER_ID in (SELECT GUE.USER_ID FROM BASE_USER_EXT GUE WHERE AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(GUE.NAME), '${@net.linlan.stage.webconfig.DbKeyConfig@dbKey}') = #{q}) OR B.USERNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')))
choose.otherwise: AND (B.MOBILE like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) OR B.USER_ID in (SELECT GUE.USER_ID FROM BASE_USER_EXT GUE WHERE GUE.NAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%'))) OR B.USERNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')))

choose.otherwise: AND B.USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT SURO.USER_ID FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN SURO WHERE SURO.ORGAN_ID = #{bindOrganId})
